task.request: Emily will be absent on Wednesday, November 4. Cover her shift while preserving pinned assignments and hour limits. Show an option with fewer reassignments and an option with lower costs.

rules.label: Confirmed availability
rules.detail: Respect absence and availability for each shift.

rules.label: Pinned assignments
rules.detail: Shifts marked “Pinned” keep their assigned employee.

rules.label: Individual hour limits
rules.detail: Daniel has an 8-hour weekly limit; other limits come from employee profiles.

rules.label: Coverage and qualifications
rules.detail: All 14 shifts must be covered by a qualified employee, without overlaps.
